ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, line $l_1$ passes through points A$(-2, 0)$ and B$(0, 2)$, and line $l_2: y = -4x + 14$ intersects $l_1$ at point C. Find the analytical formula of line $l_1$.
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Let the equation of line $ {l}_{1}$ be $y=ax+b$.\\
Since line $ {l}_{1}$ passes through points A($-2,0$) and B($0,2$),\\
we have $\begin{cases} -2a+b=0\\ b=2 \end{cases}$, solving these gives us $\begin{cases} a=1\\ b=2 \end{cases}$.\\
Thus, the equation of line $ {l}_{1}$ is $\boxed{y=x+2}$.
